test_title: SSC CHSL (2022) Tier-II Official Paper (Held On: 26 Jun, 2023 Shift 1).
subject: general
question:
**Choose the correct meaning of the underlined idiom in the given sentence.**

There is no point developing __bad blood__ with your neighbours.
solution: The correct answer is: **Enmity** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • '**Bad blood**' is an idiom that means hostility or ill-feeling between people. (लोगों के बीच शत्रुता या दुर्भावना) • **For example- ***There's always been bad blood between those two teams due to past conflicts.* • **Enmity **means the state of being actively opposed or hostile to someone or something. (किसी व्यक्ति या वस्तु का सक्रिय रूप से विरोध या शत्रुतापूर्ण होने की अवस्था) • **For example- ***The long-standing enmity between the rival gangs led to frequent clashes in the neighbourhood.* • In this context, it suggests that it's not beneficial to create a negative relationship with one's neighbours. Hence, the correct answer is **option 1**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • **Business relations**: Refers to the professional relationship between two parties. (दो पक्षों के बीच व्यावसायिक संबंध) • **Friendship**: Refers to a close relationship between two people based on mutual trust, support, and care. (आपसी विश्वास, समर्थन और देखभाल पर आधारित दो लोगों के बीच घनिष्ठ संबंध) • **Family relations**: Refers to the relationship between family members based on blood or marriage. (परिवार के सदस्यों के बीच रक्त या विवाह पर आधारित संबंध) f7:T10d4, The correct answer is: **evolved; existed**
